explication: ShipSwift is an AI-oriented SwiftUI component and recipe library, accompanied here by a showcase app for browsing its components and modules. The showcase starts at the app root and routes users through tabs to animation, chart, UI, and module demos; the package supplies reusable components, while auth and purchase managers provide the showcase’s account and Pro flows. README documents additional framework capabilities whose implementation details are not all sampled. Edges to those capabilities are documented rather than inferred from unsampled code.
